feeding_claim.verbatim: Our certified-organic herd of Jersey cows is 100% grass-fed.

resold_note: The farm store also sells raw sheep milk from Golden Fleece Farm, kefir from Milkhouse, vegetables from Ironwood Farm, salami from Small Good and other goods from Maine producers.
notes: Checked the homepage, products page, raw dairy page, farm store page, farming practices page and farm share delivery page. The raw dairy page says the Jersey herd is 100% grass-fed; the farm store page lists Organic 100% Grass-Fed Beef and Organic 100% Grass-fed Lamb, and pork as pastured; no beef finishing sentence was found beyond the product names, so grass-fed was chosen (the Verifier may upgrade if a beef page confirms no grain). Raw cow milk, half and half and cream are sold; raw milk sales are legal only in some states. Kefir and butter mentions appear tied to Milkhouse, a separate producer, so they were left out. Farm store open daily dawn to dusk. Farm share boxes are sold through the Daybreak Growers Alliance multifarm CSA with delivery locations throughout Maine. Products are also in retail stores. No bulk beef shares found. Site says MOFGA certified organic; organic labels left to the matcher. Feeding quote came from a WebFetch summary.
